info.title: Clavifer REST API
info.description: Owner administration and Agent resource APIs. Owner routes require the Better Auth session cookie and same-origin writes. Agent routes require an OAuth Bearer token with an installation-specific grant. MCP is a separate Streamable HTTP protocol at /v1/mcp, sharing the /v1 audience. Dynamic client registration is disabled; an Owner creates installation clients through /admin/clients.

post.summary: Approve or deny a pending access request
post.description: Approving may only revive a grant that is not live. When a live grant covers the same resource with a different field subset the request is refused with existing_grant_conflict, so the Owner changes the subset in the administration form instead. An approval may set expiresAt (milliseconds, or null until revoked); without it the grant lasts 24 hours. A live grant never loses reach to a shorter expiry. Approving an invocation request ignores the body, unless the invocation names another origin than its connection’s own: then origin has to repeat that origin as stored, or the approval is refused with origin_mismatch. The exact request may run once within 10 minutes. Approving a setup with a credential takes values holding exactly its fields; the credential, every connection and the approval are written in one batch under the ids fixed on submission, so a failure creates none of them; a credential name already taken (also by a deleted credential) is refused with secret_name_taken. Approving an update ignores the body and is refused with connection_changed when the connection changed after submission. Denying ignores the body.

post.summary: Request Owner approval for grants, one exact invocation, or a draft of a new or changed connection
post.description: requested holds one of grants, invocation, setup or update. A connection grant may carry paths and/or methods, a temporary scope extension beyond the connection’s allowed paths and methods that ends with the grant. An invocation (body up to 64 KiB) is checked only against the connection and its deny rules on submission, so it may lie outside the allowed paths and methods; once approved, the identical request (method, path as sent, sorted query, forwarded caller headers, body) runs once within 10 minutes through MCP http.request. REST clients add their own headers, so the REST proxy cannot replay it. An invocation may name origin, another origin than the connection’s own that the connection’s hosts or anyHost cover (host_not_allowed otherwise); the approval then runs only with that origin, and the REST proxy, which always goes to the connection’s own origin, cannot name one. A setup drafts a new credential by field names and the 1 to 20 connections using it, each with its own tests and optionally hosts but never anyHost, never an existing secret; an update changes a connection’s name, description, paths, methods or rules, never its origin or auth. Both are checked as the Owner’s forms check them and carry tests the server runs on the draft policy on submission; any mismatch refuses the submission with tests_failed, listing each one. The Owner enters a setup’s credential values on approval; neither carries a grant. An installation holds at most 20 pending requests: one more is refused with too_many_pending until the Owner decides some, while resubmitting a pending request still returns it.

parameters.description: Wildcard path below the connection policy, sent upstream as written. %2F and %20 are accepted inside a segment; policy matches the decoded path, which must not contain ";", control characters, or empty, "." or ".." segments.

OwnerCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
OwnerCookie.description: Owner browser session; mutating requests also require Origin equal to APP_ORIGIN. New grants, approving an access request, saving a connection, backup export, restore and recipient changes additionally require a login within the last 10 minutes.

AgentBearer.description: Installation token; secrets are visible only when granted, connections always (never their credential binding).

hint.description: The next step, present on every refusal an Agent can act on.

fields.description: Fields this installation may read; null means every field.

expires_at.description: When the grant ends; null means until revoked.

description.description: Usage notes the Owner wrote for Agents.

policy_json.description: JSON with the allowed paths and methods (the regular scope) and the deny / approval / free rules ("METHOD /path").

granted.description: Whether this installation holds a live connection:invoke grant.

expires_at.description: With a grant, when it ends; null means until revoked.

extensions.description: Live temporary scope extensions of this installation’s grant. A list the request left out was fixed to the connection’s setting when the grant was approved.

retentionError.description: Set when deleting superseded snapshots failed; the backup itself still succeeded.
